label: S&P 500
change: About −0.25% on Wed 25 Nov after a wild day: the index fell as much as 2.7% early as hot inflation data and AI fears hit tech, then recovered most of it. The Dow rose about 0.3% to around 50,186 after erasing a 1,100-point drop, small caps rose about 0.7%, and NYSE advancers outnumbered decliners about 2 to 1 late in the day. The index is about 6% below its 6 Oct record
source: Reuters via MarketScreener 25 Nov (incl. late-session breadth); Zhitong via Longbridge 25 Nov; CNBC 25 Nov

label: Nvidia after Huang’s return
change: About −3.9% on Wed 25 Nov (down as much as 8% early), a second day of losses after Monday’s 31% jump on Jensen Huang’s return as CEO. It is about 30% below a month ago. The board’s investigation and a congressional probe continue, and Reuters has reported SEC staff are examining possible accounting issues (no finding of wrongdoing). On Wed 25 Nov S&P Global Ratings warned it could downgrade Nvidia’s credit rating over management and governance concerns, after Moody’s cut its outlook to stable on 18 Nov
source: MarketAlleys closing tape 25 Nov; Zhitong via Longbridge 25 Nov; Yahoo Finance live 25 Nov; 24/7 Wall St 25 Nov; AP via BNN Bloomberg 26 Nov (S&P Global warning)

label: US high-yield bond spread

label: Big-tech capex outlook
change: No hyperscaler has cut 2027 plans, but cracks are showing: analyst Ming-Chi Kuo says Google is cutting 2027 shipments of a Broadcom-designed AI chip by about a fifth (neither company has commented), and Alphabet sold bonds at wider spreads than in May. UBS estimates ~30% of expected 2028 US data-centre additions could be at risk from construction pauses. Megacaps fell 3.9% on average Fri 20 Nov (Meta −5.9%, Amazon −4.1%, Microsoft −2.8%, Alphabet −2.7%)
source: TECHi 20 Nov; GV Wire (Reuters) 5 Nov; Reuters via Yahoo Finance 4 Nov

change: Closed about 4.81–4.85% on Wed 25 Nov depending on source, down roughly 6–9 bp, as investors bought bonds for safety despite hot inflation data. 2-yr about 4.59% (−8 bp), 30-yr about 5.24% late session. Bond market shut Thursday for Thanksgiving, early close Friday
source: Vista Partners 25 Nov (4.848%); The Close (Weekend Spread) 25 Nov (4.81%, 2-yr); Wallstreetcn via Longbridge 25 Nov (30-yr)

label: US Fed funds rate
change: A 25 bp hike on 9 Dec is about 98% priced (25 Nov) after October PCE inflation rose to 3.8% a year (core 3.3%, above the 3.2% expected) and Q3 GDP growth was revised up to 4.3%. Markets expect another hike in early 2027. The decision lands at 6am Thursday 10 Dec Melbourne time
source: Yahoo Finance live 25 Nov (CME FedWatch); Reuters via MarketScreener 25 Nov; JournalArta 25 Nov
